courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 船體焊道無損檢測
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以絕對壓與蒸氣壓裕量建立起點，接到空泡閃爍的取樣上限的系統介面，最後用起始判讀與重現條件整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Absolute/vapor-pressure margin, connect through Sampling of bubble flicker, then integrate evidence using Inception interpretation and reproducibility. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 船舶螺槳空蝕評估
history.text: 本專題以絕對壓與蒸氣壓裕量建立起點，接到空泡閃爍的取樣上限的系統介面，最後用起始判讀與重現條件整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Absolute/vapor-pressure margin, connect through Sampling of bubble flicker, then integrate evidence using Inception interpretation and reproducibility. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 把空蝕數、流場、影像與聲學時間對齊，區分空泡、振動及非空蝕雜訊。 在螺槳空蝕影像與訊號室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Align cavitation number, flow, images and acoustics to distinguish bubbles, vibration and unrelated noise. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Propeller cavitation image/signal studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
